title: Current MetaSWAP-MODFLOW6 phreatic storage-coupling reference

storage_mapping: MetaSWAP provides storage coefficient times SVAT area.
If MODFLOW uses storage coefficient, divide by MODFLOW cell area.
If MODFLOW uses specific storage, divide additionally by layer thickness.
The exchange writes the MODFLOW STO storage pointer directly rather than adding a second independent API storage term.

newton_phreatic_mapping.phreatic_layer_definition: For each coupled vertical MODFLOW column, select the first layer whose NPF saturation is > 0, bounded by a configured maximum coupled layer.
storage_semantics: Reset coupled MODFLOW Sy and Ss arrays before every exchange.
Write the MetaSWAP-provided storage coefficient only at the selected phreatic MODFLOW layer.
Set coupled Ss at that phreatic layer to zero.
Move recharge package nodes to the selected phreatic layer.
Read MODFLOW head at the selected phreatic layer and provide it to MetaSWAP.
newton_phreatic_mapping.ownership_interpretation: The unsaturated/SVAT model owns the phreatic storage response supplied to the groundwater solve; MODFLOW does not independently retain a second coupled phreatic Sy/Ss contribution at that location.

literature_alignment: Van Walsum and Veldhuizen (2011) describe phreatic elevation as a shared state and state that both connecting models use the same combined storage relationship.
The current iMOD Coupler technical documentation states that MetaSWAP provides recharge and sets storage in coupled MODFLOW cells.
The current iMOD example explicitly sets specific_yield=0 and describes MetaSWAP as responsible for computing the storage coefficient.

comparison_to_swap5_fgc.current_swap5: MAP11/MAP12 classify current F-GC as lower coupling-plane hydraulic-head / bottom-exchange coupling through SWAP mode 5.
comparison_to_swap5_fgc.key_difference: Current F-GC does not overwrite MODFLOW STO from a shared complete-profile SWAP storage law and does not establish its interface head as the phreatic water-table state.
comparison_to_swap5_fgc.consequence: The current F-GC route and the MetaSWAP h-link reference are different coupling contracts, not merely different implementations of an already-proven identical equation.

design_lessons_for_future_swap5_hlink: Identify the active MODFLOW phreatic cell/layer if groundwater heads can move vertically across layers.
Assign coupled phreatic storage once, with a documented rule for replacing or complementing MODFLOW Sy/Ss.
Map multiple SWAP tiles to one MODFLOW phreatic cell by area-weighted storage and recharge.
Keep internal SWAP unsaturated memory separate from the shared phreatic state.
Preserve accepted whole-window mass accounting and transaction semantics from the current F-GC architecture.
forbidden_inference: This external implementation is not SWAP5 production authority.
Do not copy MetaSWAP coefficients or numerical policies into SWAP5 without independent qualification.
Do not conclude that current SWAP5 F-GC is defective because it implements a different coupling family.
